## Summary

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behaviour. Link a related issue if one exists.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. Include screenshots for UI changes. For install, uninstall or update behaviour, give the Windows, Steam game and mod versions and distinguish what you observed on real hardware from software results. State what remains unverified.

## Compatibility and documentation

Describe changes to commands, stored files, the catalog schema, the update channel or documentation. Remove this section if it is not relevant.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and includes regression coverage where appropriate.
- [ ] `npm run check:architecture`, `npm test`, and for Rust changes `npm run lint:rust` and `npm run test:rust` pass.
- [ ] Documentation and translations (English, 简体中文, 繁體中文) are updated where needed.
- [ ] The diff and attachments contain no credentials, personal identifiers or local build artifacts.
